name: ArgoCDCli
description: Run any argocd command with the service connection's server and token injected.
helpMarkDown:
[Documentation](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks) | [Report an issue](https://github.com/WayneGoosen/azdo-argocd-tasks/issues)

Requires the CLI on PATH -- add an **ArgoCDInstall@1** step first. The token is passed to the CLI through the process environment only, never on the command line.
author: WayneGoosen

inputs.name: connection
inputs.label: Argo CD service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Argo CD server and token. Injected as ARGOCD_SERVER and ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN into the CLI process only.

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.label: Arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Arguments for a single `argocd` invocation, without the `argocd` command itself. Newlines are joined into one command line; a line starting with `#` is a comment. For several commands, use several steps.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Directory to run in. Needed for commands that read local files, such as `app diff --local`.

inputs.name: grpcWeb
inputs.label: Use gRPC-Web
inputs.helpMarkDown: Pass `--grpc-web`. Needed when the ingress in front of Argo CD does not support HTTP/2 end to end.

inputs.name: failOnNonZeroExit
inputs.label: Fail on non-zero exit code
inputs.helpMarkDown: When off, a non-zero exit reports 'succeeded with issues' and the code is still published as an output variable.

inputs.name: failOnStderr
inputs.label: Fail on stderr output
inputs.helpMarkDown: Fail if the CLI writes anything to stderr. Off by default: argocd writes progress and warnings there.

outputVariables.name: argocdExitCode
outputVariables.description: Exit code returned by the argocd command.
